			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_object_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 216 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_consumer_contract value = 216 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_resource_handover value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_resource_capacity value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_object_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_object_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_incident_serial value = var:zg361_ip_incident_serial }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_incident_source_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_source_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_incident_consequence_kind value = var:zg361_ip_incident_consequence_kind }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_type_code value = 216 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_id value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ multiply = 1000000 add = { value = $TICKET_CASE$ multiply = 1000 } add = 216 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_consumer_contract value = 216 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_due_cycle value = { value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_open value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_consumed value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_escalation_count value = 0 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_policy_debt add = 1 }
			trigger_event = { id = zg361ip.7216 days = 365 }
		}
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_score_delta add = var:zg361_ip_m216_result_score }
				change_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_evidence_n add = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_y_last_consumer value = 216 }
				if = {
					limit = { var:zg361_ip_m216_business_object_created = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_retirement_gate_used value = var:zg361_ip_m215_legacy_retired }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_consumer_complete_handover value = 1 }
					set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_object_consumed value = 1 }
				}
				else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_debt_visible_to_settlement value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_done_owner value = $TICKET_OWNER$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_done_subject value = $TICKET_SUBJECT$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_done_cycle value = $TICKET_CYCLE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_done_case value = $TICKET_CASE$ }
				set_variable = { name = zg361_ip_m216_done_state value = $TICKET_STATE$ }
			}
		}
	}
}
